answer: A knoll of per-task receipts records who did what, and the glacier of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the yarrow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. The design leans on game-theoretic equilibrium in agent coordination.
